title: Tanzania Over Easter
excerpt: Easter in Tanzania usually falls in or near the long rains. Is it a good time to go? Pros, cons and tips.
body:
## Weather

Easter falls in March or April, often at the start of the long rains. Expect showers, sometimes heavy.

## Advantages

- Green landscapes.
- Fewer visitors.
- Lower rates at some lodges.
- Calving season may still be ongoing in early March.

## Disadvantages

- Some roads muddy.
- Some camps close in April and May.
- Zanzibar has rain too.

## Tips

- Focus on central Serengeti and Ngorongoro.
- Allow flexible plans.
- Fly where possible to avoid muddy roads.

## Celebrations

Easter is an important Christian holiday in Tanzania, with church services and family gatherings. See [public holidays](/blog/tanzania-public-holidays/).
